observation.visible_scene: A low-angle, close-up view of a car's tire resting on coarse asphalt, with three soft, translucent gel toys that have googly eyes lined up along the tread: a blue one on the left, a green one in the middle, and a red one on the right. The silver wheel rim fills the upper part of the frame and shows a yellowish-green reflection in its inner barrel.
visible_changes: The green and red toys, already partly under the tire at the start, are progressively compressed into thin, flattened discs as the tread presses down on them; their googly eyes remain visible on the squished tops.
The blue toy on the left stays mostly rounded through the middle of the clip and only begins to be flattened/tilted at its upper edge near the end, when the tire's lower-left tread reaches it.
The wheel rotates (the spokes change orientation across frames) and the tire's contact line shifts relative to the toys, so the load moves across the row.

The framing is not fixed: the tire gradually moves toward the center of the image and the bright car sill at the top-left leaves the view, indicating camera movement (a pan/zoom) rather than only the toys moving.
The toys do not slide far in the frame; the dominant change is their in-place deformation (squishing/spreading) rather than translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the toys were placed and how the tire came to rest on them before this segment.
Whether the blue toy is fully crushed after the clip ends, and whether the tire rolls off the red/green toys.
The exact speed of the car and the operator's intent.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent left-right shift of the tire over the toys is due to the tire rolling, the camera panning, or both, since background cues are limited.
The precise material of the toys (gelatinous/squishy is inferred from deformation, not confirmed).
The yellowish-green area inside the rim is a reflection/inner wheel surface, not a separate object.
